decision_conditions: Time Limited PermissionThis permission is for a limited period, expiring on 16 August 2026, when the use hereby permitted shall be discontinued. The structures and works  carried out under this permission shall be removed and the land to be returned to its previous state.Reason: In granting this permission the local planning authority has had 	regard to the special circumstances of the case and wishes to have the opportunity of exercising control over any subsequent use and in order to ensure comprehensive redevelopment of the Strategic Site.

Compliance with drawingsThe development hereby approved, shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved drawings: BWD063-PL-010/B  Site Location Plan BWD063-PL-100/A  Existing Site Layout - Ground Floor LevelBWD063-PL-101/A  Existing Site Layout - First Floor LevelBWD063-PL-102/A  Existing Site Layout - Second Floor LevelBWD063-PL-103/A  Existing Site Layout - Roof Level BWD063-PL-200/D  Proposed Site Layout - Ground Floor LevelBWD063-PL-201/B  Proposed Site Layout - First Floor LevelBWD063-PL-202/B  Proposed Site Layout - Second Floor LevelBWD063-PL-203/A  Proposed Site Layout - Roof LevelBWD063-PL-400/A  Existing Elevations Sheet 1 of 2 BWD063-PL-401/A  Existing Elevations Sheet 2 of 2 BWD063-PL-410/B  Proposed Elevations Sheet 1 of 2 BWD063-PL-411/C  Proposed Elevations Sheet 2 of 2 2142-03  Rev C. UsesThe development hereby approved shall be used as a creative and cultural venue only for the following functions:o	Filming and TV studio useo	Performance and rehearsal space for theatre and the artso	Corporate and brand eventso	Exhibitions for arts and cultural/creative useso	Food and drink eventso	Community events  o	Live music eventsThe development is not to be used for any other purpose, including within any Class of the of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 as amended September 2020 (or any equivalent class in any order that may replace it), or any use for which no class is specified in Paragraph 3 (6) of the Use Classes Order and which is not listed above.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and because highway and other impacts have been assessed on the basis of the above quantum of development in accordance with policies D2 and D3 of the New London Plan (2021) and CP1 and CP2 of Enfield's Core Strategy (2010).

Hours of operationAny events held indoors shall not operate outside the hours of 0800 (8am) and 0300 (3am).Any events held outdoors shall not operate outside the hours of 0900 (9am) and 2230 (10.30pm).Reason: to ensure no undue impacts on transport and road network and neighbouring amenity.

OccupancyNo single event, or any simultaneously held combination of events, shall be attended by more than 14,999 occupants, including visitors and staff, at any given time.Reason: to ensure no undue impacts on transport and road network and neighbouring amenity.
Bicycle parkingNo later than 3 months from the date of this decision, the bicycle parking in drawing BWD063-PL-200/D shall be provided.Reason: To comply with Policy T5 of the London Plan.

Bicycle parking monitoringNo later than 6 months and 9 months from the date of this decision, the applicant shall provide information with respect to the utilisation of bicycle parking spaces for at least 6 events each.  Surveyed events must include a variety of event types, including daytime and night-time events.  Information provided must include number of spaces occupied by parked bicycles and photos of bicycle parking on site.  If at least four surveys (of the minimum 6 surveys submitted at 6 and 9 months from the date of decision) reveal that 90% or more of bicycle spaces are occupied during a surveyed event, a strategy for the provision of additional bicycle parking and a programme to deliver that parking shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The cycle parking shall be provided in accordance with the approved details and thereafter retained for cycle parking.  Reason: To ensure adequate provision of bicycle spaces that meets visitor demand.
